headline: Slack and Jira Integration Best Practices: Automate Ticket Management and PR Reviews
description: Learn the best practices for integrating Jira with Slack. Automate ticket notifications, review PRs, use slash commands, and connect Workflow Builder with Jira for seamless development workflows.
articleBody:
Integrating Jira with Slack eliminates context switching between your issue tracker and communication hub. This guide covers 5 best practices.

Best Practice 1: Install the Jira Cloud app from the Slack App Directory. Type any issue key like PROJ-123 and the Jira bot posts a summary with status, assignee, priority, and description. For Jira Server or Data Center, use the Jira Server alerts app.

Best Practice 2: Configure smart notifications per channel. Use /jira manage to subscribe channels to specific projects and event types. Route bug alerts to #bugs, feature tickets to #product, and sprint changes to #engineering. Filter by event type.

Best Practice 3: Use slash commands. /jira <issue-key> looks up any issue. /jira connect links your Jira instance. /jira manage opens the config panel.

Best Practice 4: Automate ticket creation from Slack workflows. Connect Workflow Builder with Jira to create tickets from emoji reactions, form submissions, or scheduled triggers.

Best Practice 5: Review PRs and tickets collaboratively. PR notifications in #pr-reviews, team discusses in threads, uses /jira to check tickets, and Jira transitions automatically on PR merge.

Quick reference: Issue lookup (type key or /jira), Notifications (app subscription), Ticket creation (Workflow Builder), Management (/jira manage).
